name: b8-3-bootstrap-confirms-policy
prompt: Re-run bootstrap on this repo and tell me exactly what the overwrite policy is.
expectations: confirms the target and the overwrite policy
appends to .gitignore, never overwrites it (node_modules survives)

assertion_labels.contains:run:transcript.md:overwrite: explains the overwrite policy before acting
assertion_labels.contains:repo:.gitignore:node_modules: the existing .gitignore entry survived the install
